additional_info.subject: ID045265-DC/Si-D/IL-[MP / P4 170000446] Error on LEM DC Meter CRM:02888000305
additional_info.body:
Dear Ziv, good morning.
The error disappeared over night without needing to have the configuration changed. I will explain to you in detail about the error.
The error that I saw in our backend is that the log file of the LEM was full and not able to recover. According to the instructions, we are not allowed to modify this file and as such, there is only 2 possibilities:
LEM itself fixes it
Replace LEM meter
Since the LEM resolved it by itself, let's keep this ticket opened until Monday and if it reoccurs, we will proceed with checking with the Field Service team to go there and solve it.
For now, the charger looks to be working 100% and I didn't change the configuration. I will monitor it until Monday for any charging sessions on DC1.
What do you think? I will wait for your feedback.
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: ID045265-DC/Si-D/IL-[MP / P4 170000446] Error on LEM DC Meter CRM:02888000305
additional_info.body:
Hello Ziv, good morning.
Unfortunately, the error returned and we need to replace the part. Since this charger is out of warranty, how do you prefer? The charger works without the LEM meter.
Please let me know if you want to proceed with the replacement, and if yes, Orel will order the component.
For now, I removed the configuration so that the outlet works.
I will wait for your feedback.
Best regards,
Francisco
